summary: Deep-audit-reconciled precision obligations for native PM-owned fff-inspired discovery. This contract is source-lineage for a later explicit compile and is not canonical Plans prose or gate-clean certification.
discovery_request_required_fields: credential_handle_ref without secret material when SSH-backed
receipt_payload_required_fields: selected_result_ids as opaque/redaction-profiled ids when applicable

gui_query.over_budget_behavior: return partial, stale, or fallback results with freshness_state and fallback_state disclosed

agent_discover_paths.over_budget_behavior: return partial, stale, or fallback results with receipts and requires_exact_verification

cold_local_index.behavior: index in background and expose warming/index_cold state instead of blocking the UI

remote_or_ssh.over_budget_behavior: return stale remote_cache or ssh_manifest results only with explicit freshness/fallback disclosure

resource_caps.cap_behavior: compact, evict, or degrade with over_budget/fallback receipt before exceeding configured limits

penalties: stale or fallback results are penalized but may remain visible with disclosed freshness/fallback state
generated/vendor/ignored paths are downranked or excluded according to FileSafe and ignore policy
denied and hidden_by_policy candidates are not success-shaped ranked results
tie_breakers_in_order: current worktree/branch/remote identity over adjacent identities
source files before generated/vendor/cache files when policy allows both
privacy: Agents receive sanitized score_breakdown and ranking effects, not raw private frecency/query/open history by default.
GUI rank explanations may show coarse reasons such as path match, recent in this project, current context, stale cache, or fallback.

ssh_topology.mvp_topology: local DiscoveryService plus SSH remote manifest adapter
remote_manifest_strategy: Use Git-tracked file manifests such as git ls-files when available.
Use an allowed remote directory walk fallback only inside the authorized remote project root.
Normalize, policy-filter, and annotate remote entries before they enter the local DiscoveryIndex.
ssh_topology.remote_helper_policy: No persistent PM remote daemon is required for MVP. A later optional remote helper may be added only if it implements the same request/result/policy/freshness contract.
ssh_topology.cache_key_rule: Cache/index keys are derived from a normalized remote identity hash and must not include secrets or merge unrelated local paths.
ssh_topology.verification_rule: Exact verification for SSH results reads through the authorized remote identity/path or a provenance-equivalent remote cache entry; it must not verify an unrelated local checkout as if it were the SSH result.
ssh_topology.fallback_rule: Allowed fallback order is fresh remote manifest, stale remote manifest with disclosure, explicit remote_cache/ssh_manifest fallback with disclosure, then no-results or error. Silent local substitution is forbidden.
ssh_topology.auth_error_behavior: SSH auth failures, passphrase prompts, known-host changes, remote command denial, host unavailable, and manifest missing states emit explicit fallback/error receipts and user-visible prompts or degraded states where appropriate; they never silently become fresh local success results.

assistant_chat_setting.label: Show file discovery activity in chat
assistant_chat_setting.description: Show when assistants look for candidate files, use stale or fallback indexes, select files, and verify them.
assistant_chat_setting.thread_shortcut: Assistant Chat thread overflow may link to this setting, but MVP does not need separate per-thread semantics.
when_on: Show routine discovery.invoked, discovery.candidates_returned, discovery.selected, fallback/degraded path, and discovery.verified activity in the thread.
when_off: Hide routine inline discovery progress cards in Assistant Chat threads.
Still show permission prompts, denied or hidden-by-policy safety messages, fallback/stale disclosures that affect user trust, final relevant summaries, exact-verification linkage, and auditability.
assistant_chat_setting.receipt_policy: Durable receipts remain available in Runtime Artifacts / audit views regardless of the chat visibility setting.
assistant_chat_setting.scope_boundary: The setting controls routine discovery progress presentation only. Permission prompts, approval cards, denied/hidden-by-policy safety messages, fallback/stale disclosures that affect user trust, exact-verification linkage, durable receipts, and final relevant summaries are never suppressible by this setting.

validation_acceptance_cases: Local 250k-path warm query meets p95/p99 targets or emits over_budget/fallback receipts.
GUI query cancellation completes within 100 ms when a newer query supersedes it.
Agent bug-fix with no exact path uses discover_paths, then exact verification before edits.
Ranking is deterministic for identical request/index/frecency state.
Assistant Chat setting on shows routine discovery activity; setting off hides routine progress while preserving safety and audit-visible information.
SSH project with no local checkout returns remote candidates with identity/freshness/fallback provenance and never uses unrelated local paths.
Denied and hidden_by_policy candidates do not leak blocked filenames through candidate rows, summaries, counts, or fallback diagnostics.

Disabled or unsupported discovery emits discovery.disabled or discovery.unsupported receipt behavior and falls back to existing exact-path/grep/codesearch/Instant Grep/Quick Open/FileManager behavior without silent behavior drift.
Path identity tests prove canonical_path_identity is separate from display_path across separator, Unicode, symlink, case-sensitivity, worktree, and remote identity variants.

Cache invalidation tests prove schema_version, ranking_policy_version, policy_hash, ignore_hash, identity_hash, and manifest generation changes rebuild, downgrade with disclosure, or discard unsafe cache state.
Scheduler tests prove dedupe, superseded GUI cancellation, bounded refresh concurrency, GUI/background fairness, and discovery.backpressure or over_budget receipts.
SSH auth tests cover passphrase prompt, known-host change, remote command denial, host unavailable, and no secret/path leakage in receipts or prompts.
Retention tests prove frecency/query/open-history reset stops future ranking use for the selected identity without deleting durable Runtime Artifacts receipts by default.

GUI route migration tests prove Quick Open, command palette fuzzy file search, Assistant Chat file mentions, Search path narrowing, and FileManager type-ahead route path discovery through DiscoveryService without undisclosed duplicate ranking or command rename churn.

Ambient invocation tests prove agents use discovery only when repo/source location is materially needed and skip it for verified exact paths, pure chat tasks, user-forbidden discovery, policy-blocked contexts, disabled/kill-switch states, unsupported surfaces, or backpressure states.
negative_constraints: Do not treat this contract as permission to edit canonical Plans.
Do not create Plans/.plan_index, WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, Spec_Lock, shards, evidence, plan_graph, or auto_decisions from this ledger turn.
Do not replace Instant Grep / grep / codesearch content verification with DiscoveryService ranking.
Do not add a direct fff runtime dependency as the product direction.
Do not weaken SSH remote identity, freshness disclosure, FileSafe/permission policy, or no-local-fallback behavior.

visibility_and_redaction_policy.candidate_count: Visible post-policy count only. Blocked or hidden counts are omitted, bucketed, or redacted; they are never used to create rank gaps or diagnostics that reveal blocked path identity.
visibility_and_redaction_policy.selected_result_ids: Opaque identifiers scoped to the request/receipt and redaction_profile, not raw path strings for unauthorized consumers.
visibility_and_redaction_policy.display_path: User-visible display_path is emitted only after policy filtering and may be generalized or redacted.
visibility_and_redaction_policy.matched_ranges: Matched ranges are omitted or redacted when they would reveal hidden path segments.
visibility_and_redaction_policy.diagnostics: Fallback summaries, stale notices, health messages, and rank explanations must not leak blocked filenames, blocked counts, secret material, or unauthorized remote identities.

triggers: read/search misses where path discovery is materially useful
remote or SSH project orientation when exact path is absent
skips: discovery disabled or kill switch active
over-budget/backpressure state where existing exact tools are safer
ambient_invocation_policy.boundary: Ambient discovery means agents use discover_paths when locating repo code is materially needed; it does not mean search everything every turn.

compile_readiness_caveats: This ledger is source-prepared for an explicit compile request; it is not gate-clean compile certification.
